label: Regenerate compile_commands.json
args: python -c "import glob, json, os, shutil, subprocess; root = os.getcwd(); gpp = os.environ.get('GPP') or os.environ.get('GPP_PATH') or shutil.which('g++') or 'C:/mingw64/bin/g++.exe'; inc = os.path.join(root, 'include'); files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(root, 'src', '*.cpp'))); entries = [{'directory': root, 'file': f, 'command': subprocess.list2cmdline([gpp, '-std=c++17', '-g', '-pthread', f'-I{inc}', '-c', f, '-o', os.path.join(root, 'build_obj', os.path.basename(f) + '.o')])} for f in files]; open(os.path.join(root, 'compile_commands.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(json.dumps(entries, indent=2))"
